title: Implement P115 wire references and migrate owned machine consumers
status_proposal: blocked until the explicit owner direction is recorded on main
description:
Outcome: implement the exact signed P115 v1.0 machine-wire contract and atomically migrate every owned current-answer reader and named parity/cache/ceiling comparison. Valid observed answers carry one complete three-field governing-intent Unknown per workItems observation and one literal local ref per served item; claims stay distinct and human rendering/counts remain unchanged. This is one cohesive compatibility outcome, one worker and one PR, not separate producer/consumer or UI/backend tasks.

Non-goals: no spec or frozen-package edit, recorder/tag act, new SQL/read column/title/text/consent/egress, global reference framework, alternate inline arm, persistence, entity/relationship pooling, second truth model, limit/auth/readiness-policy change, provider, private/live runtime/body read, deployment/release or unattended coordination. No historical evidence/capture rewrite.

Governing intent: POC-REQ-014 at the signed tag and its applied POC-REQ-010..013,042,060 constraints, RFC2-24, VIS-2; PWB-REQ-006/020/021/022 retain their original scopes. The signoff record itself grants no implementation. The new direction, once actually approved and recorded, is the missing implementation/migration authority.

Packet-complete does not mean runnable. Keep held until the owner-gate and fresh source/dependency/ownership checks below pass. No product implementation bead was created as part of preparation.
design:
Source binding: use the exact head/tree/tag in metadata, SIGNED-SUBJECT-CHECK.json (six subjects) and the retained full 649-file census. Revalidate after intervening main changes; preserve foreign dirt. CONSUMER-DISPOSITIONS.json covers all59 candidate files and four operator readers. OWNED-FILES.json enumerates the exact proposed existing/new edit paths. Root alone owns canonical direction/state/tracker/PR lifecycle records.

Implementation: keep the domain WorkItemFact/WorkItemsResult and logical PocModel unchanged. A narrow app-boundary poc-machine-wire.ts checks every complete logical item value before transforming it, projects one observation shared literal plus refs without mutation, and validates that closed wire form. Route ordering: existing credential gate; request links/served readiness; closed projection+validation; wire contentKey/ETag using unchanged identity algorithm; JSON serialization; final UTF-8 byte limit; conditional304 only after successful validation/limit checks. Use original evaluation for the exact POC-REQ-014 failure. No process-global reference cache, new identity exclusion or fallback.

Consumers: TypeScript admission is reused by fresh-checkout-demo and accessible-names operators; a stdlib-only Python helper admits the two retained-capture scripts. Validate the complete work-item branch before any claims/counts/source populations. Keep raw wire bytes/objects for size/hash/ETag and representation metrics. An effective semantic view is distinct and never rehashed as if it were the wire. Independent parity expander is literal/test-owned, imports no producer/serializer/model helper, enumerates complete served N, rendered R and separate epistemic records, and checks carrier shapes and actual claim identity populations.

Migration/concurrency/retry: publish all owned changes atomically. Internal unmerged checkpoints may stage implementation, but no intermediate inline/ref release or format negotiation is allowed. GETs are read-only/idempotent, two answers cannot lend values, concurrent/repeated requests preserve the same declared facts/order, and retries start from their own complete received body. Invalid/partial input is an explicit fault with no derived totals. No added retry loop or durable state.

Compatibility/rollback: old inline bodies fail current P115 admission, with historical offline reproduction pinned to the old tool revision. The separate /api/poc/polaris envelope is unchanged. Pre-merge abandon/repair the branch; post-merge source rollback is whole-change, attended and disclosed as restoring an implementation gap, with no automatic live downgrade/restart. An invalid current response fails503/rejects. External/dynamic consumers, actual savings/runtime/service state remain Unknown.

Tests/docs: extend the nearest existing tests named in the matrix and TEST-DELTA-PLAN.json, including33 independent invalid-form vectors. Preserve logical mutant clones while replacing claimed machine surrogates with actual route bytes. Initial Tests:+2 Python methods(8 named subcases),~18 named TS blocks,-0; +0 TS it blocks. Explain any necessary additional block before expanding. Add the Python consumer component step to existing node-ci without altering canonical governance battery accounting. Update THREE-SURFACE-POC operator guidance, add the P115 migration guide and link it from docs/README. Signed OpenSpec and package documents remain untouched.

Verification: after explicit authorization, isolate worktree/npm ci first; build:poc; run changed focused suites and existing core work-items/model/trajectory/identity regressions; run python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_poc_machine_wire.py. Record actual outputs/denominators, then use exact-head required CI and one independent whole-PR reviewer. Guard mutations must fail the intended assertion with positive executed test counts and retain old/new fragments plus subject commit; no prior native/signoff battery transfer. Browser fixtures use owned synthetic servers only. Private/live runtime measurement/body reads remain a separately gated future verification outcome.

Incoming-main refresh: CURRENT-SOURCE-REFRESH.json independently enumerates652 current source inputs at d621bfa267f24ff68f6f83ac7bfba44b81a32a34, same59 candidate paths and exact6 signed subjects. All25 owned implementation/test bodies are unchanged; docs/README is the sole26th owned body change. Preserve the new unrelated model.test.ts digest/freeze tests and rebase the docs index normally. Initial source evidence remains973965a; no later review/CI approval is implied.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Owner gate: an actual authenticated A naming the independently reviewed packet is recorded by root in the dedicated owner direction on main before implementation. Refresh canonical Beads dedupe/ownership/dependencies and actual PR changed-file overlaps. One shared-model lane/PR; no foreign reassignment. Until these hold, metadata implementation_authorized remains false and the bead is blocked.
2. Exact protocol: observed workItems carries one and only one complete literal shared Unknown, every item carries exactly {"ref":"observation"}, and every logical item is proven identical before mapping. Preserve complete ordered N, all metadata/evaluation/observation identities, full separate claim/entity/relationship records, title withholding and original logical model. Unknown observation has no shared/items/count; measured observed empty has one shared value,items[],count0,no item claims.
3. Fail closed: missing/altered/extra shared fields, every route/action field, inline/malformed/recursive/external/cross-observation refs and differing logical values produce the exact bounded503 before200/304; current consumers explicitly reject before any claims/totals. A valid preceding body cannot repair an invalid successor. Preserve auth/resource failure causes, do not fabricate Unknown reason/readiness arm/resource event/verified evidence.
4. Cache/bytes: independently recompute contentKey/ETag from actual served wire including route links and unchanged25 exclusions. Old inline ETag cannot get304 for the new body. Invalid or too-large body cannot get304. Direct/tailnet final UTF-8 limit−1/limit/limit+1 cases retain16MiB machine ceiling and all original refusal behavior; no truncation/paging/population loss.
5. Independent parity: oracle literal expansion is independent of production/serializer/model helpers; own enumerations prove N,R,N−R, claim keys and complete carrier population. Human Unknown encoding/reason/route/warrant text and narrowed membership remain identical, including title sentinel and separate records. Use actual route answers for asserted machine comparisons; preserve unrelated logical clone tests.
6. Owned migration: all four operator readers and every dispositioned changed comparison move in the same PR. Raw received bytes remain byte/hash/identity subjects. No inline compatibility arm or historical evidence rewrite. Any necessary path beyond OWNED-FILES requires explained scope review before editing; frozen core/signoff/registry/human/core model paths remain untouched.
7. Test delta: implement the existing-test extension plan and two Python methods/eight named subcases; retain and run all current assertions. Report actual Tests:+N ~M -0 and native denominators. Retain failed guard controls with actual old/new fragments and commit; zero-test/import failures do not satisfy them. No source-spelling grep guard, test-only production hook or redundant policy battery.
8. Documentation/verification: operator docs describe the current wire contract, typed refusal, closed reader admission, raw versus semantic identity, historic offline reproduction and runtime gate. Focused synthetic tests, typecheck/build and required exact-head CI pass; one independent whole-PR review and normal protected merge complete. No live service/body/provider/deploy action is performed. Report runtime conformance, savings, external consumer compatibility and active service state as Unknown.
9. Completion: root records the protected merged implementation commit and exact-head evidence, links the closed specification carrier and preparation packet, and reports the remaining separately gated live verification. Do not reopen syzygy-318o or claim this bead adopts intent.
